prompt:
A realistic open hardcover journal photographed from a high angle, almost top-down with a very slight tilt (about 10-15 degrees), centered on a plain warm beige background. Cream textured paper pages, thick visible page stack on both sides, caramel-brown leather cover peeking out at the edges, slightly curved pages at the center gutter. A wide coral-red fabric ribbon bookmark runs down the center fold and hangs out past the bottom edge of the book.

Left page: a small paper tape label at the top-left corner with the typewriter text "12.10", a white-bordered instant-print style photo of a young Asian couple laughing in a cozy cafe, iced coffee and cake on the table. Below the photo, a handwritten thin cursive caption: "Ngày có nhau".

Right page: a white-bordered photo of the same couple from behind, walking by a riverside at golden hour sunset, city skyline in the distance, soft pink-orange sky.

Soft natural window light from the upper left, gentle drop shadows under the photos and the book, warm film-like color grading, palette of cream, beige, caramel, coral and soft peach. Cozy, nostalgic, romantic, minimal. Shallow depth of field, high detail, 4k.

Production framing: one photorealistic product render only, landscape 4:3 composition, complete open book and ribbon visible with generous clean margins all around. No website text, buttons, UI card, extra props or frames. Keep camera yaw and roll effectively zero; tilt only slightly from top-down. Both pages equally sized and readable, undistorted faces. Photographic material realism: tactile cotton fibers, fine paper edge layers, natural leather grain and woven ribbon, not plastic.
